data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the right order (weather search, 10 Day forecast, BBC "<city> strike" search, draft the heads-up email, discard), but it has no tab-switching or open-first-result step, it names the recipient email and name as separate parameters instead of one traveler used in {traveler}@example.com, and it lists "forecast values" and "news headline" as parameters when those are read from the pages, so an automation would have to guess some details.
